# Rise Roofing

> Rise Roofing is a Los Angeles roofing contractor providing roof repair, replacement, inspections, flat roof repair, emergency roofing, and storm damage support across Los Angeles and nearby cities. Call (818) 714-7330 for a free estimate.

## Services

- [Roof Repair](https://riseroofingav.com/services/roof-repair): Leak tracing, shingle repair, flashing fixes, and targeted roof work.
- [Roof Leak Repair](https://riseroofingav.com/services/roof-leak-repair): Leak tracing to the real source plus flashing, shingle, and penetration fixes.
- [Roof Replacement](https://riseroofingav.com/services/roof-replacement): Replacement planning for aging, storm-damaged, or failing roofs.
- [Residential Roofing](https://riseroofingav.com/services/residential-roofing): Repairs, replacements, inspections, and storm help for single-family homes.
- [Commercial Roofing](https://riseroofingav.com/services/commercial-roofing): Flat and low-slope roof repair, replacement, and maintenance for managed properties.
- [Flat Roof Repair](https://riseroofingav.com/services/flat-roof-repair): Low-slope, membrane, seam, and ponding-water repair for commercial and residential flat roofs.
- [Roof Inspections](https://riseroofingav.com/services/roof-inspections): Post-storm, pre-sale, insurance, and maintenance roof checks with clear findings.
- [Emergency Roofing](https://riseroofingav.com/services/emergency-roofing): Urgent help for active leaks, exposed roof sections, and storm damage.
- [Storm Damage Roofing](https://riseroofingav.com/services/storm-damage-roofing): Wind damage, lifted shingles, leak follow-up, and insurance-claim conversations.

## Service areas

- [Los Angeles](https://riseroofingav.com/service-areas/los-angeles): Roofing services across Los Angeles.
- [Pasadena](https://riseroofingav.com/service-areas/pasadena): Roof repair for tile, slate, and aging shingle roofs.
- [Glendale](https://riseroofingav.com/service-areas/glendale): Roofing and roof repair for Verdugo foothill homes.
- [Burbank](https://riseroofingav.com/service-areas/burbank): Roof repair, replacement, inspections, and storm damage help.
- [Santa Monica](https://riseroofingav.com/service-areas/santa-monica): Coastal roof repair, inspections, and replacement planning.
